brief: Goldman Sachs desk note, 3 Sep 2026. US equity indices held a range for roughly three weeks while rotation ran underneath: desk demand moved to the broadening out trade after July's momentum unwind, into cyclicals, financials and AI-proof software. Hawkish FOMC rhetoric after Jackson Hole forced the market to price September hikes, about 52% odds. Revised Fed expectations, AI-supported growth and fiscal pressure are the primary drivers of rates, leaving 20-year yields near multi-year highs and the curve about 5 points steeper on the week, with GS Rates Strats calling long-end yields around 5% reasonable. Real assets caught a bid on a debasement trade, Bitcoin +30% and gold +5.5% over the month. Positioning is the swing factor: fundamental long/short gross exposure is 207% and net 47.6%, with long/short ratios at over 1-year lows, so hedge fund re-grossing could provide the next leg higher, while the Q3 buyback blackout beginning around 9/15 removes a cushion. Momentum composition is shifting, software into the 3-month long leg and semis/AI into its short leg. September seasonality is negative, and CPI on 9/11 and the 9/16 FOMC are the tests. Mutual fund tilts, record 2026 issuance and tax loss baskets are reported, not argued.
